_comment: SERVICES — the canonical record of what this studio sells.
Before this file existed the five services lived only as hand-written
markup in index.html, and service 04 was called four different things in
four places on one page (docs/124 §3). One name per service now lives
here, and everything that renders a service name reads it from here.
`id` is language-neutral and permanent. It is what a CRM, a project
management board, a quotation or an agent keys on, and it must never be
translated, renamed or reused.
ONE NAME PER SERVICE, ON EVERY CLIENT-FACING SURFACE. The owner settled
this on 8 September: the pricing index, the package buttons, the hero
diagram and the ecosystem flow all say "Social Media Management" and
"Digital Marketing & Advertising" in full. A shortName field existed here
for one commit and is gone: a declared abbreviation is still an
abbreviation, and docs/124 §3 found this service called four different
things in four places because nothing forced agreement.
build-catalogue.js now requires every pricing category's label — in both
languages — to be EXACTLY this name, and qa.js §40 requires every surface
that renders a service name to carry it verbatim. `aliases` records what
each was called before, and those strings are now FORBIDDEN as display
names rather than merely documented.
THE ID IS NOT THE LABEL AND NEVER FOLLOWS IT. `svc.social` stays
`svc.social`, the pricing category stays `social`, the packages stay
`soc-starter` / `soc-growth` / `soc-pro`. Renaming an id to match a label
would break every join in this catalogue to change some words on a page.
`legacyCategory` is the id this service's packages carry in
src/data/pricing.json. It is a JOIN, not a duplicate: the packages and
their prices stay exactly where they are.
`pipeline` is PART 02 of the brief: the ordered sequence a service is
actually executed in. Each stage names the features that belong to it, so
a selected scope can be sorted into an executable order rather than a
shopping list. Stage ids are permanent for the same reason feature ids
are.
NOTHING IN THIS FILE REACHES A VISITOR WHOLE. tools/build-catalogue.js
emits a public projection carrying labels, descriptions, pricing and
dependencies only. Pipelines, stages and automation fields stay here.

summary.en: One consistent look across every channel.
summary.ar: مظهر واحد متسق في كل قناة.

description.en: Logo, identity and visual systems that give your business one consistent look across every channel.
description.ar: شعار وهوية وأنظمة بصرية تمنح عملك مظهرًا واحدًا متسقًا في كل قناة.

stages.objective: Establish what the business is, who it speaks to, and what the identity has to survive.
stages.entry: Signed scope and a completed brand questionnaire.
stages.exit: A written direction the client has agreed to in words, before anything is drawn.

stages.objective: Build the three things everything else is derived from.
stages.entry: Agreed direction.
stages.exit: Logo, colour system and type system approved.

stages.objective: Turn the core into rules other people can follow without asking.
stages.entry: Core identity approved.
stages.exit: Guidelines and visual language documented.

stages.objective: Apply the system to the surfaces the business actually uses.
stages.entry: Core identity approved. Guidelines where the scope includes them.
stages.exit: Every applied item approved at its own revision limit.

stages.objective: Produce original imagery where the identity needs it and stock will not do.
stages.entry: Approved direction. A shot list agreed with the client.
stages.exit: Selected, retouched files delivered.

stages.objective: Hand over files the client owns and can use without us.
stages.entry: Every in-scope item approved.
stages.exit: Archive delivered and receipt confirmed.

summary.en: Designed, built, and handed over working.

description.en: Design, build and deployment — handed over as a working website, with domain and hosting arranged.
description.ar: تصميم وتطوير ونشر — يُسلَّم موقعًا يعمل، مع تجهيز النطاق والاستضافة.

stages.objective: Agree what pages exist, what each is for, and what the site has to do.
stages.entry: Signed scope.
stages.exit: An agreed sitemap and a content list naming who supplies each item.

stages.objective: Secure the address and the place the site will live.
stages.entry: A chosen name, confirmed available, and the client's decision on who holds the account.
stages.exit: Domain registered and hosting provisioned, both in the client's name.

stages.objective: Design every page at every width before any of it is built.
stages.entry: Agreed sitemap. Brand assets, ours or the client's.
stages.exit: Design approved at desktop and phone widths.

stages.objective: Build the approved design as a working site.
stages.entry: Approved design. Final copy and images in hand.
stages.exit: Every page built, responsive, and matching the approved design.

stages.objective: Prove it works before anyone else sees it.
stages.entry: Build complete on a staging address.
stages.exit: Every check passed and recorded.

stages.objective: Put it live and hand over the keys.
stages.entry: Testing passed. Client sign-off on the staging site.
stages.exit: Live on the client's domain, credentials transferred, receipt confirmed.

description.en: Strategy, content and publishing across your channels, with community monitoring and performance analysis.
description.ar: استراتيجية ومحتوى ونشر عبر قنواتك، مع متابعة المجتمع وتحليل الأداء.

pipeline._comment: A MONTHLY LOOP, not a line. Onboarding runs once; plan, produce, publish, engage and report run every month, and the report feeds the next month's plan.

stages.objective: Get access to the accounts and agree the voice.
stages.entry: Signed scope.
stages.exit: Publishing access confirmed on every in-scope platform.

stages.objective: Decide what goes out this month, and why.
stages.entry: Approved voice. Last month's report, from month two onward.
stages.exit: A calendar the client has approved.

stages.objective: Make everything the calendar promised.
stages.entry: Approved calendar. Brand assets and any client-supplied material.
stages.exit: Every item approved at its revision limit and scheduled.

stages.objective: Put it out on time, on the right account.
stages.entry: Approved content, scheduled.
stages.exit: Every scheduled item live, verified on the platform itself.

stages.objective: Answer people, and escalate what we cannot answer.
stages.entry: Published content.
stages.exit: No unanswered message older than the agreed response window.

stages.objective: Say what happened, what caused it, and what changes next month.
stages.entry: A complete calendar month of published activity.
stages.exit: Report sent. Next month's plan carries at least one decision taken from it.

description.en: Paid campaigns across the major platforms, with audience targeting, campaign management, optimization and tracking.
description.ar: حملات مدفوعة على المنصات الرئيسية، مع استهداف الجمهور وإدارة الحملات وتحسينها وتتبع النتائج.

note.en: The advertising budget itself is not included in the management fee. The package price covers managing your campaigns; what you spend with the platforms is separate and paid by you.
note.ar: ميزانية الإعلانات نفسها غير مشمولة في رسوم الإدارة.

pipeline._comment: Setup runs once per campaign. Measure and optimise run continuously; report and review close each month and set the next month's target.

stages.objective: Get into the ad accounts, legitimately and reversibly.
stages.entry: Signed scope.
stages.exit: Partner access granted on every in-scope platform, with the client owning the account.

stages.objective: Decide who we are talking to and what counts as success.
stages.entry: Account access. An agreed objective and a monthly budget figure from the client.
stages.exit: A written target, a defined audience, and a conversion the client agrees to be measured on.

stages.objective: Make the ads.
stages.entry: Approved audience and target. Brand assets.
stages.exit: Copy and creative approved, and compliant with each platform's policy.

stages.objective: Make the result measurable before the money starts moving.
stages.entry: A destination we can put a tag on, and the client's permission to place it.
stages.exit: A test conversion recorded end to end.

stages.objective: Build the campaign and turn it on.
stages.entry: Approved creative. Tracking verified. Budget confirmed in writing.
stages.exit: Campaign live, delivering, and spending at the agreed daily rate.

stages.objective: Improve the result while it runs, without breaking what works.
stages.entry: A live campaign with enough data to read.
stages.exit: Each change recorded with the number that justified it.

stages.objective: Say what the money bought, and what changes next month.
stages.entry: A complete calendar month of spend.
stages.exit: Report sent with spend, result and cost per result, and a decision for next month.

summary.en: All of the above, run as one system.
summary.ar: كل ما سبق، يُدار كنظامٍ واحد.

description.en: The complete connected offering, run as one system from brand through to growth rather than as separate projects.
description.ar: العرض المتكامل بالكامل، يُدار كنظام واحد من العلامة حتى النمو بدل أن يكون مشاريع منفصلة.

_note: THIS SERVICE HAS NO PACKAGES AND NO PRICE, and that is the truth about
it rather than a gap. It is the other four run together, so its price
is whatever the chosen scope is; the brief's instruction is to show
'Custom quote' rather than invent a number, and that is what it does.
Its pipeline is the four services' pipelines in dependency order, not
a sixth set of stages. A composition that had its own hidden workflow
would be a fifth service pretending to be a bundle.

stages.objective: Build the foundation.
stages.entry: Signed scope across the composed services.
stages.exit: Brand core approved — everything downstream depends on it.

stages.objective: Create the digital presence.
stages.entry: Brand core approved.
stages.exit: Site live on the client's domain.

stages.objective: Build ongoing engagement.
stages.entry: Brand core approved. A destination to send people to.
stages.exit: The monthly loop running.

stages.objective: Reach the right audience.
stages.entry: A live destination and measurable conversions.
stages.exit: Campaigns live and reporting monthly.
